svg.text: Actual frequency: Codesys trace vs oscilloscope
Same run. Codesys: GVL.iFrequency_Actual (input 0x06), traced every 4 ms. Oscilloscope: PUL pin, 5 ms average.
At this scale the two overlap.
Zoom: 1 s of the ramp up
Codesys gets a new value every 140 ms,
so it lags the pin by up to ~280 Hz during a ramp.
